What I've saved in Trove is mine, so it should just stay put. Once I've saved a link — especially after I've tweaked the title or description, written a note, and put labels on it — none of that should quietly change or vanish because the website did something on their end.

So if the page later changes its title or description, I wouldn't want Trove to silently overwrite what I saved with the new version; my copy stays as I left it. And if the page disappears entirely, everything I kept — the title, description, my note, and my labels — should still be right there in my collection. The whole reason I'm saving these is so I don't lose them, so a link going bad on the web shouldn't take my saved details down with it.
